name: Forum Vote
description: One row per entitled voter on a motion. Entitlement is recorded by creating the row, whether or not a vote is cast — which is what makes 'who was entitled', 'who voted' and 'how' three one-query answers.

fields.label: Membership
fields.description: The seat that conferred entitlement. Checked against the motion's decision date, not today.

fields.label: Voter
fields.description: Snapshotted from the seat when the motion opened, so a later occupant change does not rewrite who voted.

fields.label: Acting For
fields.description: Set when the vote was cast by a delegate.

fields.label: Position
fields.options:
Not Cast
For
Against
Abstain
Recused
fields.description: A ballot value, not a workflow state: it is counted, and the count is stored on the motion.
